metadata.description: Official Octoparse agent skills — agent-driven web data extraction across ~670 cloud templates

plugins.name: octoparse
plugins.description: Universal web data extraction through ~670 Octoparse cloud templates, run via the Octoparse MCP server. Covers lead generation and contact enrichment, e-commerce price monitoring and product research, review and reputation analysis, company and supplier research, job and talent-market research, property and travel listings, social listening, and search-result capture — across Google Maps, Amazon, Temu, TikTok Shop, LinkedIn, Indeed, Yellow Pages, Gelbe Seiten, Pagesjaunes, Naver, Suumo, Booking, and hundreds more sites in English, Japanese, Spanish, French, German, Italian, and Korean.
